rows.en: But hear this! Rings have been set up at points all along the routes to the Tower,
and there you must fight the opponents we designate, and win!
You ruffians!! Run wild to your hearts' content!!
"WOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAAAAH!!!"
Settle the grudges you've nursed for years!!
"WOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAAAAH!!!"
Then be the last one standing and seize the crown of victory!!
"WOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAAAAH!!!"
The "Regis Fight" preliminaries! "Survival Eleven"... Ready... GO!!
"GOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO!!!"
The matchups and their venues appeared on the giant monitor set up in the arena.
"Ooooooooooh~~~"
Hey! Are you the one they call Snowgon?
I am the Snowman Imagin. I'd rather not be lumped in with such a barbaric kaiju.
Where's this Ultra Space Port supposed to be, anyway?
The contestants checked their opponents and venues, then began preparing for battle.
We're checking our matchup too.
{8074} and the team checked the monitor.

Opponent: Granzairas
Venue: Floor 1 Center - Ultra Colosseum
Hah? This place?
And on top of that, our opponent is Granzairas...!
Indeed. You heroes draw a great deal of attention.
So I've prepared the finest stage for you from your very first bout. I expect a fight worthy of it.
Now then, are you ready?
Then allow me to introduce your opponent! The mightiest kaijin of the Kaima Realm, Granzairas!
Fuhahahaha!! Not that I have any need for preliminaries, but...
Eh, this'll make a nice warm-up.
Granzairas...!!
Hm...? Well, if it isn't Black RX. Been a while.
Never thought I'd run into you in a place like this!!
You, of all people, I will never forgive!!
Now, may both sides fight with no regrets! Survival Eleven, Match 1...
Readyyyyy... GOOOOOOO!!
Not ready yet, you say? That only proves your fighting spirit has gone slack.
The first preliminary match will now begin! Are you ready?
We did it!
We did it!!
Yeah! We did it!!
Hell yeah!
That was a formidable foe.
Heh... Well, that's about how it goes.
Phew... We somehow managed to win...
Good!
Let's keep this up and win the next one too!
That's one down!
All right, we did it!
Mission complete.
Target destruction confirmed.
Splendid. Keep that up and fight your way through.
I shall be waiting for you at the Plasma Spark Tower!
The details of the next match appeared on the monitor.

Opponent: Over Flags
Venue: Floor 1 North - Ultra Space Port
The Over Flags...!!
The anti-Gundam investigation unit... An elite squad of Over Flags...
The next match, huh... So what're you gonna do?
Nothing to decide. At this point, winning our way through should be the fastest way to the Tower.
Your destination has been marked on the MAP.
The next match, huh... So what're you gonna do?
Nothing to decide! At this point, winning our way through should be the fastest way to the Tower.
...At this point, winning our way through has got to be the fastest way to the Tower!
Nothin' to decide. At this point, winning through is what you'd call the shortcut to the Tower.
At this point all we can do is keep winning! We're headed straight for the top of the Tower!
Nothing to decide. At this point, winning our way through should be the fastest way to the Tower.
Nothing to decide. At this point, winning our way through is the fastest way to the Tower.
Now we have no choice but to keep winning! I think that's the fastest way to the Tower!
Nothing to decide. At this point, winning our way through should be the fastest way to the Tower.
Nothing to decide. At this point, winning our way through should be the fastest way to the Tower.
Nothing to decide. At this point, winning our way through should be the fastest way to the Tower.
What're we gonna do...? Winning our way through is the fastest way to the Tower now, right?
Nothing to decide. At this point, winning our way through should be the fastest way to the Tower.
So this is the match venue... Are you all ready?
Hurry up and get going.
So you're our opponents!!
We are an elite unit formed to thoroughly investigate, capture, and eliminate the Gundams!
The Over Flags...!!
That's right, they call us the Over Flags!! ...!?
There you are! GUNDAAAAM!!
To think we'd meet at this tournament of all places... I can't help but feel it's fate!
I want to hold you in my arms, Gundam!

notes.note: #0.70/0.72/0.74/0.76/0.78: crowd reactions in corner brackets, no speaker; rendered as quoted shouts, identical JP kept identical.
Tournament names kept in quotes as in source: 'Regis Fight', 'Survival Eleven'. 'Ready... GO!!' echoes the G Gundam fight call. Not in glossary.

Match card kept as a deliberate two-line layout. Dai-1-sou rendered 'Floor 1' (no earlier precedent found). Ultra Colosseum / Ultra Space Port / Plasma Spark Tower not in glossary; used standard Ultra-franchise English.
#0.96, #0.99, #0.112 have no speaker label; context makes them Master Gundam (the MC).
Kaima-kai rendered 'Kaima Realm' (Kaima is the glossary term; 'Realm' not in glossary).

#0.117-0.129 leader variants; order from the 0414.bla index function (Pt_Chara_Check 2,5,4,3,1,15,14,12,11,6,7,9,10): RX, OOO, W, Momotaros, Rider 1, Zero, Mebius, Seven, Ultraman, Nu, Zeta, Wing Zero, 00. Voices match (Heero 'Mission complete', Setsuna 'Target destruction confirmed').
Over Flags (the Overflag squad) spelled after the glossary's 'Over Flag'; group name not in glossary.
'There's nothing to decide' for the set phrase meaning there is nothing to think over. Rows #0.151/154/155/156/158 have identical JP and identical English.

#0.147-0.158 follow the same leader order (RX..Wing Zero); the 00 slot is unused because 00 has its own branch (#0.139-0.142). #0.152 (Zero) drops the conjectural ending, so 'is' instead of 'should be'.
Zeta (Kamille) echoes Ankh's question back; rendered 'What're we gonna do...?'.
No speaker label; likely Ankh or the leader prompting before the fight. Kept neutral.
Script labels this Wing Zero (CHARA_NAME 9), possibly a decompile artifact of a party-dependent speaker; content suggests the Gundam who knows the Over Flags (00). Line is neutral either way.
Graham Aker's catchphrase from Gundam 00, used by the Over Flag leader; rendered with the familiar 'hold you in my arms' wording.

report: All 80 rows translated. Leader-variant order for #0.117-0.129 and #0.147-0.158 taken from 0414.bla. Uncertain: 0418 #0.12 speaker label (Wing Zero vs 00); 0418 #0.1 speaker unlabeled. Not in glossary: Regis Fight, Survival Eleven, Over Flags (group), Ultra Colosseum, Ultra Space Port, Plasma Spark Tower, Kaima Realm.
